DASRULEPACK.ShadowBlade.Name: Shadow Blade
DASRULEPACK.ShadowBlade.Advantage: Shadow Blade: Advantage, the target is in dim light or darkness.
DASRULEPACK.ShadowBlade.Dissipated: {name}'s Shadow Blade dissipates. A Bonus Action (casting the spell again) makes it reappear.
DASRULEPACK.Blade.WhichWeapon: Which weapon do you make the attack with?
DASRULEPACK.Blade.NoWeapon: {spell}: you need a melee weapon in hand (equipped) to cast it.
DASRULEPACK.Blade.Sheathed: Booming Blade: sheathed in booming energy
DASRULEPACK.Blade.SheathedHint: Booming Blade is on this creature. A move of 5 ft or more made by choice sets it off ({dice}d8 thunder) and removes it; so does the start of the caster's next turn.
DASRULEPACK.Blade.LeapTo: The attack hit {target}. Which creature within 5 feet of it does the green fire leap to?
DASRULEPACK.Importer.Plutonium.Name: Items imported by Plutonium
DASRULEPACK.Importer.Plutonium.Hint: These items carry their activities and effects under other ids than the official item, so the automation DAS has for them may do nothing, or only part of it. The repair replaces each one with the official item (same id; uses spent, preparation, equipment and quantity kept; Plutonium's flags kept). Classes, subclasses, origins and items with advancements are only listed: their choices can't be carried over, replace them by hand.
